responsibility: Declares helper functions for deciding when identifiers need mangling, encoding and decoding assembler-safe Go symbol components, and escaping struct tags for type-literal names. This header exposes the symbol-component encoding API used by name generation, type mangling, and backend-name construction in the Go frontend.
same_name_distinction: Declares the identifier-encoding helper functions used by symbol and type-name generation. Unlike go-encode-id.cc, it presents the API for checking, encoding, decoding, and tag mangling without implementing the character-by-character encoding rules.
